# Infinus Website - LLM Training Data

## Company Overview
Infinus is an SAP Gold Partner focused on SAP Business Suite solutions including:
- SAP Cloud ERP (Private and Public)
- SAP Business Data Cloud
- SAP Business AI
- SAP Business Technology Platform

## Services
1. SAP Implementation Services - Greenfield, brownfield, conversions, migrations and rollouts
2. SAP Support Services - SAP Application Management Services and SLA Support Services
3. Other Services - SAP localisation support, developments, trainings, etc.
4. ProjectPulse - SAP Qualified Partner-Packaged Solution (QPPS) for Professional Services firms

## ProjectPulse Solution Details
ProjectPulse is an ERP-based solution that connects service delivery, resource planning, invoice readiness, profitability, and cash visibility in one end-to-end flow. It standardizes the Project-to-Profit flow from project setup and staffing to execution, billing, profitability, and close.

Key Features:
- Structured delivery and staffing discipline
- Invoice readiness and billing blockers visible early
- Real-time margin and cash visibility by project and customer
- Embedded analytics, AI, and integrations with existing tools
- Pre-built integration patterns
- Curated analytics

Implementation Timeline: Typically 4-6 months from kickoff to go-live
Implementation Phases:
1. Discover (2-3 weeks) - Requirements & fit analysis
2. Fit-to-Standard (4-6 weeks) - Configuration & customization
3. Build & Integrate (6-8 weeks) - Development & integration
4. Test & Train (3-4 weeks) - UAT & user enablement
5. Go-live & Hypercare (2-4 weeks) - Launch & stabilization

Ideal For:
- Consulting & Advisory
- IT Services
- Systems Integration
- Software Development
- Outsourcing & Nearshoring
- Creative & Digital Agencies
- Architecture & Design
- Engineering
- Legal

ProjectPulse URL: https://www.infinus.co/projectpulse
